tasks.subject: Task 1: Vocabulary, validator, CI gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `taxonomy.json` exists, a pure validator enforces it, and `tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh` gates that validator in CI — with the catalog still carrying no per-module assignments.

**Files:**
- Create: `taxonomy.json`
- Create: `tools/catalog/taxonomy.mjs`
- Create: `tools/catalog/sync_taxonomy.mjs`
- Create: `tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh`
- Modify: `module-catalog.json` (top-level `taxonomy` block only)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `taxonomy.json` lists the 5 component_types with subcategory slugs and labels, plus the known tag list
- [ ] `validate()` returns [] for the real catalog (no module has a subcategory yet)
- [ ] Every validation rule is proven able to FAIL by a mutation in the test
- [ ] `module-catalog.json` carries a `taxonomy` block byte-identical to `--write` output; `--check` fails on drift
- [ ] `bash tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh` exits 0

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh` → prints `PASS: taxonomy` and exits 0

**Steps:** See plan Task 1 Steps 1-9: write taxonomy.json; write tools/catalog/taxonomy.mjs (loadJson/derivedTags/embedBlock/validate); write tools/catalog/sync_taxonomy.mjs (--check/--write); write tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh with 10 mutation rules; run test (fails: embed out of date); run --write; rerun test (PASS); confirm --write is idempotent; run whole tests/host suite; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Assign all 133 modules
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every catalogue entry carries a `subcategory` and a sorted `tags` array, and the validator now requires a subcategory so a new module cannot be added without one.

**Files:**
- Modify: `module-catalog.json` (all 133 module entries)
- Modify: `tools/catalog/sync_taxonomy.mjs`
- Modify: `tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All 133 modules have a subcategory valid for their component_type
- [ ] Every module with non-empty `requires` carries `needs-assets`; no module carries it otherwise
- [ ] tags arrays are sorted and de-duplicated
- [ ] Adding a module with no subcategory fails the test
- [ ] `bash tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh` exits 0

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh` → `PASS: taxonomy`, and `node tools/catalog/sync_taxonomy.mjs --check` → `taxonomy ok`

**Steps:** See plan Task 2 Steps 1-7: write the 133-row assignment TSV (verbatim in the plan); apply it with the node script (inserts subcategory/tags after component_type, merges derived needs-assets); --check; flip requireSubcategory to default-on and add mutation 8b; run test; spot-check the distribution; run the suite and commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["module-catalog.json", "tools/catalog/sync_taxonomy.mjs", "tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh && node tools/catalog/sync_taxonomy.mjs --check", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all 133 modules have a subcategory valid for their component_type", "needs-assets present iff requires is non-empty", "tags sorted and de-duplicated", "a module with no subcategory fails the test", "tests/host/test_taxonomy.sh exits 0"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Manager filters by subcategory
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `/modules` gains a second filter row built from the catalog's own taxonomy block, a subcategory badge on each card, and tag pills — reusing the filter/sort/persist machinery already in modules.html.

**Files:**
- Modify: `schwung-manager/main.go`
- Modify: `schwung-manager/templates/modules.html`
- Modify: `schwung-manager/templates_test.go`
- Modify: `schwung-manager/static/style.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] CatalogModule carries Subcategory and Tags; Catalog carries Taxonomy; the modules.html data map carries a Taxonomy key
- [ ] Cards and list rows carry data-subcategory
- [ ] A second filter row renders one button per subcategory present in the current list, intersecting with the category filter
- [ ] Selecting a category hides subcategory buttons belonging to other categories
- [ ] Tag pills render on the card
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes in schwung-manager/

**Verify:** `cd schwung-manager && go build ./... && go test ./...` → `ok`

**Steps:** See plan Task 3 Steps 1-9: extend CatalogModule/Catalog + add CatalogTaxonomy/CatalogSubcategory; add subcategoryLabelFor and register it as the subcategoryLabel template func; put Taxonomy in handleModules' data map (zero value when cat is nil); add the filter row keyed on the (component_type, subcategory) PAIR; add data-subcategory/data-tags to all four card and row elements; wire the JS filter, visibility pass and persistence; style; add the render helper and two Go tests; build, test, commit.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Catalog site filters by subcategory
tasks.description:
**Goal:** schwung.dev/catalog.html gains subcategory chips built from the taxonomy block, tag pills on each card, and a synced catalog copy.

**Files:**
- Modify: `../../schwung-catalog-site/data/module-catalog.json`
- Modify: `../../schwung-catalog-site/catalog.html`
- Modify: `../../schwung-catalog-site/app.js`
- Modify: `../../schwung-catalog-site/style.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] data/module-catalog.json is byte-identical to the schwung repo's
- [ ] A subcategory chip row renders under the existing category filter, built at RUNTIME from the catalog's taxonomy block
- [ ] Category and subcategory filters intersect
- [ ] Tag pills render on each card
- [ ] catalog.html loads with no console errors and the filters work

**Verify:** `cd ../../schwung-catalog-site && python3 -m http.server 8765` then open http://localhost:8765/catalog.html — chips render, filtering works, console clean

**Steps:** See plan Task 4 Steps 1-7: cp the catalog and diff; add the hidden chip container; build chips at runtime keyed on the (component_type, subcategory) pair, add the visibility/release pass, filter in getFiltered, call the pass first in render(); render badge + tag pills via subcategoryLabel(); style; verify in a browser; commit HUNKS ONLY — manual.html in that repo is dirty with an unmerged Boot menu section, never git add it or use git add -A.
